text:
maria: Kickoff — landing copy sprint for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Primary goals: final hero lines, benchmark highlights, webinar gating, and lead routing. Two-week cadence?
aj: Two weeks fine. propose pre-launch post + webinar invite next Wed.
noah: I'll sketch three hero concepts in Figma by Friday morning. one compact and one with metrics.
sam: I'll pull benchmark bullets tying latency (p95), throughput, and $/k tokens. Also a one-pager with a short prompt set for the webinar demo.
tess: I'll build the webinar page and HubSpot form. confirm routing: mode param -> hubspot tag; hosted -> inbound SDR, dedicated/private -> AE + SE.
maria: Correct. Use tags: mode, region, acct_tier. UTM campaign: "launch_pulse_v1" for posts. Gate the detailed latency report as "latency-playbook.pdf" behind the webinar reg.
aj: Hero copy candidates (short):
  Hosted: "Hosted API — start small, scale instantly."
  Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — predictable throughput, reserved GPUs."
  Private: "Private deployment — data control and enterprise security."
noah: Alternative tone (engineering-forward):
  Hosted: "Turn on hosted inference — minimal ops, instant API."
  Dedicated: "Reserve GPUs for steady production latency."
  Private: "VPC and on-prem deployments with KMS integration."
sam: Benchmark bullets to support each hero: 
  Hosted: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, burst capacity notes.
  Dedicated: p95 under sustained load, concurrency guarantees, SLA snippet.
  Private: audit logs, KMS/HSM, compliance attestations.
maria: Launch post structure: 1) quick benchmark takeaway 2) product modes explained 3) customer vignette + what to expect in webinar 4) CTA to register and download latency-playbook.pdf
tess: Webinar plan: title "Serving LLMs at Scale: Performance, Cost, and Deployments". 25 minutes total: 15-min product + 6-min demo + 4-min Q&A. Speakers: Sam (PM), Rachel (Eng), Lewis (Solutions). Date: Wed 10am PT.
aj: Social post drafts due Monday. I'll draft LinkedIn + X copy: short punch + link to webinar + UTM.
noah: For the registration form I'll add a hidden field `mode` so each page sets it. sample: ```<input type="hidden" name="mode" value="private">```
tess: HubSpot routing pseudo: 
```
if (mode === 'hosted') tag='inbound_hosted';
else if (mode === 'dedicated') tag='ae_dedicated';
else tag='ae_private';
createContact(contact, [tag, utm_campaign]);
```
maria: Defaults: landing pages default to Hosted hero when mode missing. Ensure all post links include utm_source and utm_campaign. Add tracking key: `landing_launch_stage_v1`.
aj: CTA variants to A/B test (two weeks):
  Variant A: "Get started — Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Request private consult"
  Variant B: "Try Hosted now" / "Talk to sales — Dedicated" / "Book private demo"
sam: Set experiment id `launch_cta_v2` in GA. We'll measure CTR and conversions to registration.
noah: UI microcopy idea for hero subhead: "One API. Three deployment profiles. Choose your SLA."
tess: Email subject for webinar invite: "Webinar: Serving LLMs — Performance & Deployment"; preheader: "Join us for benchmarks and a live demo."
maria: Action items: 
  - noah: Figma hero + export frames + a11y checklist (due Fri EOD)
  - sam: benchmark one-pager + prompt set + CSV (due Thu)
  - tess: webinar landing + form + HubSpot workflow (due Mon)
  - aj: social + blog draft + scheduling (due Mon)
  - maria: coordinate dry-run Mon, confirm publish window and UTM map (due Mon EOD)
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy window Wed 08:00 PT. Assets to /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
maria: Let's reconvene Wed 09:00 PT for a final go/no-go. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
